# SortReceipts

> SortReceipts is a browser-based receipt scanner and cost tracker for small restaurants, cafés and food trucks. Photograph a printed supplier invoice or receipt; the app reads the vendor, amount, date and tax, files it under one of 8 restaurant cost categories, and keeps monthly revenue, expenses and gross margin current. Nothing to install — it runs in a browser.

Full content for retrieval: https://sortreceipts.qianling-tech.top/llms-full.txt
Long-form guide: https://sortreceipts.qianling-tech.top/guide
Questions and answers: https://sortreceipts.qianling-tech.top/faq
Company and product facts: https://sortreceipts.qianling-tech.top/about

## Problems it solves

- **Month-end catch-up**: receipts sit in a drawer until the last day. SortReceipts records each one when it happens, so the month closes without a backlog.
- **Retyping totals**: vendor, amount, date and tax are read from the photo instead of typed by hand.
- **Not knowing where the money went**: every expense carries one of 8 restaurant cost categories, and the category split plus margin trend sit on one screen.
- **Reformatting before handing books to an accountant**: monthly reports export as CSV, which Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets open directly.

## Who it is for

Independent restaurants, cafés and food trucks that deal with paper supplier invoices. One project represents one store or one line of business, and projects keep separate books.

## How it works

1. Create a project (one store or one line of business).
2. Photograph the supplier invoice and check the four extracted fields: vendor, amount, date, tax.
3. Confirm the cost category: Food & ingredients, Payroll, Rent, Utilities, Platform fees, Advertising, Office supplies, Other.
4. Read the monthly report: revenue, expenses, category split, gross margin and profit. Export to CSV at month end.

## What it does

- Reads printed receipts and supplier invoices from photos in JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each.
- Extracts vendor, total amount, invoice date and tax amount from the recognised text.
- Files each expense under one of 8 restaurant cost categories: Food & ingredients, Payroll, Rent, Utilities, Platform fees, Advertising, Office supplies, Other.
- Tracks daily revenue and computes gross margin: revenue minus recorded invoice spend.
- Builds monthly reports: revenue, expenses, category split, margin and profit trend.
- Exports reports as CSV on paid plans.
- The product interface is available in English and Chinese. The marketing site also has pages in Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese and Korean.

## Pricing (USD, monthly)

- Free: 5 invoices a month, 1 project, basic reports, no CSV export.
- Pro: $3.99 — 200 invoices a month, 10 projects, CSV export, AI business review.
- Enterprise: $13.99 — unlimited invoices and projects, priority support.

## Limitations

- Printed receipts work best. Handwritten notes and poorly lit photos may need manual correction.
- Amounts are stored as entered; the app is not a tax filing service and does not compute VAT returns.
- The product interface is available in English and Chinese only. Other languages cover the marketing page, not the product itself.
